reviews.thesis: The late-September breakout accelerated from 93,300 to 112,400 in five sessions, but 10/7 rejected 113,700 and closed near the low while RSI remains above 70 with bearish divergence; the original breakout level is now too distant for clean asymmetry.
reviews.confirmation: A controlled pullback that holds the 99k-104.2k post-breakout shelf and then reclaims 112,400-113,700
reviews.chaseJudgement: Current price is materially extended from the accepted breakout structure; do not chase.
reviews.counterargument: The breakout was backed by several sessions of strong trading-value expansion and can remain in momentum regime despite the first rejection.

reviews.thesis: The 46,300-46,400 spring/retest area survived the 10/6 undershoot and 10/7 recovered to 47,850, creating a nearby defined-risk support test after the September decline.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Probe is attractive only near the reclaimed 46.4k floor; chasing above 48.75k enters prior supply.
reviews.counterargument: The sequence since early September is still lower-high/lower-low and 48k-50k has repeatedly acted as supply.

reviews.thesis: The 3,590 box breakout remains accepted, but the four-session expansion to 4,025 was followed by a 10/7 pullback; current price is still above the breakout yet structural invalidation at 3,225 is too wide for a fresh entry.
reviews.confirmation: Retest and hold 3,590-3,650 followed by renewed acceptance above 3,945-4,025
reviews.chaseJudgement: Wait for a breakout-level retest rather than buying the middle of the expanded range.
reviews.counterargument: Momentum and volume expansion since 9/30 are strong enough that a shallow consolidation could resume without a deep retest.

reviews.thesis: The 10/1-10/6 breakout leg expanded roughly 40% from the 170,800 structure and 10/7 printed a high-volume upper rejection from 257,000; despite the strong trend, current location is far beyond any nearby structural invalidation.
reviews.confirmation: Orderly pullback that holds the 203k-210k breakout shelf and later reclaims 246,500-257,000
reviews.chaseJudgement: Do not chase after the vertical four-session expansion and 10/7 rejection.
reviews.counterargument: Trading-value expansion remains exceptional and the breakout can transition into a higher momentum regime after consolidation.

reviews.thesis: The 28,100-28,150 area is being tested after a month-long decline from 33,100; 10/7 touched 28,100 and closed back at 28,250, giving a very tight support-location probe despite weak momentum.
reviews.confirmation: Defend 28,100 on closing basis and recover 29,050-30,000
reviews.chaseJudgement: Only a support-location probe is justified; a rebound chased above 30k loses the asymmetry.
reviews.counterargument: The September-October structure remains a clear lower-high/lower-low sequence and repeated tests can exhaust 28.1k support.

reviews.thesis: Price has recovered toward the 6,268-6,530 resistance band with expanding activity, but the 6,230 close leaves little immediate room before established supply and the broader base has not yet broken out.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Current price is directly beneath resistance; wait for either a retest or confirmed breakout acceptance.
reviews.counterargument: The 10/7 close was strong and expanding trading value may be an early sign of a genuine base reversal.

reviews.thesis: The 33,800-34,250 area has repeatedly contained downside since mid-September and price is again close to that floor; upside toward the 38.7k-39k density offers defined asymmetry if the floor holds.
reviews.confirmation: Hold 33,800 and recover 35,250-35,650; stronger confirmation above 36,650
reviews.chaseJudgement: Probe only near the established floor; do not chase a rebound into 38.7k-39k resistance.
reviews.counterargument: The broader weekly trend has been declining since August and the box floor has been tested repeatedly without strong demand.

reviews.thesis: The September impulse remains visible, but 10/7 fell from 4,030 to a near-low 3,645 close after the 10/6 spike, breaking the short-term recovery rhythm; nearest clean trend-bridge support around 3,185 is still far below.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Do not treat the 10/7 selloff as an automatic dip-buy; wait for close acceptance and recovery.
reviews.counterargument: The pullback occurred on contracting activity and the larger September trend bridge remains above its structural invalidation.

reviews.thesis: Price is near the lower portion of the 72,000-82,500 building box after a multi-week decline; 10/6 showed a rebound from 74,400 and 10/7 retained the 74,800 area, allowing a defined lower-box probe.
reviews.confirmation: Hold the 72k-74.8k lower box and recover 76,900-79,500
reviews.chaseJudgement: Probe only in the lower box; chasing toward 81.5k-82.5k compresses reward.
reviews.counterargument: The September trend remains downward and 10/7 closed near the session low, so no durable reversal is confirmed yet.

reviews.thesis: The September recovery remains above the old 8,350 trend-bridge level, but 10/7 rejected 9,380 and closed near the low at 8,790; the chart is between support and 10,380 resistance without a clean trigger.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Wait for a support retest or reclaim; the current middle location after an upper rejection is not clean.
reviews.counterargument: The 8.35k trend bridge has held through multiple pullbacks and could support another recovery leg.

reviews.thesis: The 19,610-19,820 lower box area remains intact after repeated late-September/October tests, and current price at 19,870 is close enough for a tightly defined support probe despite the prevailing downtrend.
reviews.confirmation: Hold 19,610 and recover 20,400-20,550; stronger confirmation above 21,000
reviews.chaseJudgement: Only attractive at the box floor; a rebound chased above 20.5k immediately meets prior supply.
reviews.counterargument: The weekly trend has been deteriorating since August and repeated floor tests can precede a breakdown.

reviews.thesis: The August trend bridge at 11,500 remains the nearest accepted support, but 10/7 rejected 13,420 and closed near the low at 12,370; the current level is between support and the 14,248-14,320 resistance cluster.
reviews.chaseJudgement: Do not chase inside the middle of the range after 10/7 upper rejection; wait for support or renewed acceptance.
reviews.counterargument: Trading activity contracted on the pullback and the August trend bridge remains structurally valid.
